summary: Process-global registry mapping provider name strings to SecretsResolver callables (str -> str). Provides register_secrets_resolver() (write-once), get_secrets_resolver(), replace_secrets_resolver() (explicit overwrite), and clear_secrets_registry() (test cleanup). SecretsResolver is a type alias for Callable[[str], str].
extension_points: register_secrets_resolver() — plug in any secrets backend (AWS SSM, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, etc.)
lifecycle_notes: Write-once by default — register_secrets_resolver raises ValueError on duplicate provider name
documentation_hooks: Usage: register a resolver before constructing any settings with secrets_provider='my_provider'
Resolver signature: (secret_reference: str) -> str — receives the portion after 'secret:' prefix
